theorems.name: Submission.dtc_cone_radial_tangency
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (a : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → R.measure (ball 0 ρ) = a * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x
